name: CoAuthors
description: A collection of all the CoAuthor objects in the document.
remarks: The CoAuthors collection contains all the co authors in the document (authors that are actively editing the document).
example:
Dim i As Integer

i = ActiveDocument.CoAuthoring.Authors.Count

MsgBox "The number of co authors is " & i

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified CoAuthors object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the CoAuthors collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual CoAuthor object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned.
